name: How long does an exterior weathering assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an exterior weathering assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior weathering assessment typically depends on the size and complexity of your roof. For an average residential roof, the on-site inspection usually takes between 30 minutes to 2 hours. This timeframe allows our inspectors to thoroughly examine all roof surfaces, penetrations, and drainage systems. The preparation of the detailed report follows the on-site visit and may take a few business days. We aim to provide efficient yet comprehensive service.
acceptedAnswer.description: An on-site assessment usually takes 30 minutes to 2 hours, depending on roof size. The full report follows within a few business days.
